items.title: Bill Allred interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: I heard that Tommy Dorsey and I shared the same birthday, November 19.

ctx.x: Did you have a metal one?

Yes. I had a metal one that came apart which a couple of people said boy you should have saved that. But anyway, I took it back to the rental place and got a trombone because I heard that Tommy Dorsey and I shared the same birthday, November 19. The total reason for that. And I saw it in Photoplay magazine.
